richContent.intro: Industry Army Marketing welcomes [Cabins.ltd](https://cabins.ltd/), a focused publication for people thinking about buying a cabin, preparing one for sale or researching a prefab cabin project. The site brings those three paths together with practical reading and private worksheets, so readers can turn an attractive idea into a clearer set of questions.

sections.heading: Three different paths, one useful starting point
paragraphs: Buying an existing cabin, selling a property and ordering a prefab package involve different decisions. Cabins.ltd gives each a separate starting point. The buying section considers the information behind a property, the seller section helps organize a description and records, and the company directory links readers to prefab makers.

The launch is an editorial resource. Cabins.ltd does not display verified property inventory, take bookings or process a property purchase. Its cabin photographs illustrate the subject; they do not represent properties currently offered through the site. That distinction stays visible while readers explore.

sections.heading: Prepare a cabin for a better buyer conversation
paragraphs: The [seller brief](https://cabins.ltd/sell/) helps an owner organize the facts they want to explain. A useful cabin description connects the building with its setting, access, documents and unanswered questions. The accompanying journal covers writing that description, planning a photo sequence, gathering a records pack and preparing for a viewing.

Readers can save their working brief in their own browser and download it themselves. This is a preparation tool, not a submitted listing or a request sent to an agent. Keeping that boundary clear lets people work through their notes before deciding what to share and with whom.

sections.heading: Look beyond the view when buying
paragraphs: The [cabin property section](https://cabins.ltd/real-estate/) points toward questions that deserve attention before a transaction: what is known about the land and building, what records exist and which matters need a qualified local assessment. The journal includes dedicated notes on water records, septic information and viewing questions.

These are prompts for investigation rather than a remote inspection. A general guide cannot confirm a particular cabin’s water quality, access rights, septic condition, permitted use or suitability for a buyer’s plans. Readers should take the questions to the relevant authority, seller and professional for that property.

sections.heading: Compare prefab companies through their own documents
paragraphs: The initial [prefab company directory](https://cabins.ltd/companies/) introduces DEN Outdoors, The Backcountry Hut Company and Koto, with links to the companies’ own sites. Supporting stories look at package descriptions, documentation and comparison questions.

A compelling photograph does not establish what a package includes. The practical task is to separate the product or system from site preparation, delivery, assembly, local approvals and other project responsibilities. Cabins.ltd helps readers prepare that conversation; it does not speak for a manufacturer, issue a quote or certify a company.

sections.heading: Sixteen stories and a private project brief
paragraphs: The [launch journal](https://cabins.ltd/journal/) contains sixteen short stories spanning buying, selling, design, planning, prefab research and cabin life. Topics include understanding the land before the cabin, putting a budget around unanswered questions, thinking about daylight and keeping useful handover records.

The [project brief](https://cabins.ltd/planner/) gives readers a place to record how they want to use a cabin, what they know about a site and which decisions remain open. Like the seller brief, it is a browser-local planning aid. It does not submit a building application, arrange a contractor or establish project feasibility.

sections.heading: Explore the live publication
paragraphs: Start with the buying or selling path that fits your situation, browse a prefab company profile, or use a journal story to shape the next question. Cabins.ltd adds a distinct cabin-focused publication to the Industry Army Marketing network, with useful preparation tools and clear limits on what the current site provides.

Visit [Cabins.ltd](https://cabins.ltd/) to explore the live site. This announcement describes the public editorial launch and its existing tools; it does not claim that listing intake, payments, bookings or autonomous publishing are active.

cta.heading: Give your industry a useful resource
cta.body: Talk with IAM about a focused website or publication built around the questions your audience actually needs answered.
